title: 旅行预算情景计算器
prompt: 我们两大一小去三亚五天，预算一万。机票和酒店选不同档次，总共会差多少？
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, note])
$flightTier = "economy"
$hotelTier = "budget"
$showDetails = false
intro = Text("两大一小去三亚 5 天，预算 10,000 元。下面的机票与酒店金额为示例估算，仅用于比较不同档次的价差，不是实时报价，也不会创建订单。", "md", "muted")
tool = TravelModule([RadioGroup($flightTier, flightChoiceLabels, "机票档次", "pills"), RadioGroup($hotelTier, hotelChoiceLabels, "酒店档次", "pills"), Divider(), summary, detailsToggle, $showDetails ? details : null], "choices", "三亚 5 天 · 两大一小", "示例价格 · 非实时报价")
note = Text("如需按指定日期或实际航班/酒店报价重新测算，请告诉我出发城市和入住区域。", "sm", "muted")
flightChoiceLabels = [{value: "economy", label: "经济舱"}, {value: "comfort", label: "舒适舱"}, {value: "business", label: "公务舱"}]
hotelChoiceLabels = [{value: "budget", label: "经济酒店"}, {value: "comfort", label: "舒适酒店"}, {value: "resort", label: "度假酒店"}]
flightOptions = [{value: "economy", label: "经济舱", adult: 1800, child: 900}, {value: "comfort", label: "舒适舱", adult: 2600, child: 1300}, {value: "business", label: "公务舱", adult: 4800, child: 2400}]
hotelOptions = [{value: "budget", label: "经济酒店", night: 400}, {value: "comfort", label: "舒适酒店", night: 750}, {value: "resort", label: "度假酒店", night: 1400}]
selectedFlight = @Find(flightOptions, "value", $flightTier)
selectedHotel = @Find(hotelOptions, "value", $hotelTier)
flightTotal = selectedFlight.adult * 2 + selectedFlight.child
hotelTotal = selectedHotel.night * 4
total = flightTotal + hotelTotal
remaining = 10000 - total
minFlight = @First(flightOptions)
maxFlight = @Last(flightOptions)
minHotel = @First(hotelOptions)
maxHotel = @Last(hotelOptions)
minTotal = minFlight.adult * 2 + minFlight.child + minHotel.night * 4
maxTotal = maxFlight.adult * 2 + maxFlight.child + maxHotel.night * 4
rangeDiff = maxTotal - minTotal
summary = Col([Row([Caption("当前组合"), Spacer(), Text(selectedFlight.label + " + " + selectedHotel.label, "sm", "ink", "semibold")]), Row([Caption("预计合计"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(total, "number", 0), "lg", "ink", "semibold")]), Row([Caption("与 1 万预算比"), Spacer(), Text(remaining >= 0 ? "余 ¥" + @Format(remaining, "number", 0) : "超 ¥" + @Format(@Abs(remaining), "number", 0), "md", remaining >= 0 ? "success" : "danger", "semibold")]), Row([Caption("最低 vs 最高"), Spacer(), Text("相差 ¥" + @Format(rangeDiff, "number", 0), "sm", "warning", "semibold")])], 2)
detailsToggle = Button($showDetails ? "收起明细" : "查看组合明细", @Set($showDetails, !$showDetails), "ghost", "primary", "sm", $showDetails ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down")
details = Col([Divider(), Col([Row([Caption("当前机票（2 大 1 小往返）"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(flightTotal, "number", 0), "sm")]), Row([Caption("当前酒店（4 晚家庭房）"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(hotelTotal, "number", 0), "sm")]), Row([Caption("最低组合"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(minTotal, "number", 0), "sm")]), Row([Caption("最高组合"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(maxTotal, "number", 0), "sm")])], 2), Table(comboColumns, comboRows, "9 种组合对比", "top")], 3)
comboColumns = ["组合", "机票", "酒店", "合计", "与预算差"]
comboRows = @Flatten(@Each(flightOptions, "f", @Each(hotelOptions, "h", [f.label + " + " + h.label, "¥" + @Format(f.adult * 2 + f.child, "number", 0), "¥" + @Format(h.night * 4, "number", 0), "¥" + @Format(f.adult * 2 + f.child + h.night * 4, "number", 0), @Format(f.adult * 2 + f.child + h.night * 4 - 10000, "number", 0)])))
